=== Native Lifeforms ===
Native life is minimal, consisting of algae and simple worms in damp sub-surface soil pockets.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
This world was known to the [[Vilani]] as Kadkaagi.

During the [[Long Night]], it became a colony of [[Sidur Ishki (world)|Sidur Ishki]]. When [[Gumahl]] raiders first threatened the colony, the Sidurii naval forces stationed there chased them out of the system. However, an administrative error later halted local funding for the navy.
